reviews.title: Noctua excellence....
reviews.comment:
The beauty of 140mm fans is the extra air movement so they can run at lower temps.
I use these on my NH-D15 coolers and outside of very heavy loads, they run whisper quiet. Even gaming they are near dead silent.  Make sure to adjust your fan curves as for normal usage on my 9900k @ 5.1ghz I can keep the fans running at ~25% speed and temps are nice and low.
Like just about every fan, when pushed under very heavy loads they are audible but in a large floor fan kind of way and not a high pitched way which is a plus.
The sound dampeners of various colors is a nice touch if your case happens to adhere to a certain RGB color scheme.
5/5

reviews.title: Can not say enough GOOD about this fan!
reviews.comment: I recently built me a new box and installed NINE of these fans in it. Easy to install and work like a charm. Can hardly hear the NINE fans running which are just to my right. Love the fans and how quiet they really are. Would highly recommend! Great product!
reviews.author: Copperhead

reviews.title: Great like the original tan/brown fans, just wish it was sold with the NH-U14S cooling solution.
reviews.comment: Great like all Noctua solutions, I just wished they offered the NH-U14S cooler with these fans stock. I bought a pair of these to keep my setup all black. That's the only reason why I gave the "value for money" a 2 stars. Noctua should just allow the buyer to pick the fan color desired when getting the cooler but despite "wasting" money buying a black pair of these to stifle my OCD I'm extremely happy with the cooling performance and noise levels given my hardware.
